source: 1001 三月七 战技 可爱即是正义 (100102, BPSkill/Defence): 「为指定我方单体提供能够抵消等同于三月七#1[i]%防御力+#4[i]伤害的护盾，持续#2[i]回合。」 param Lv10 = [0.57, 3, 0.3, 760, 5] → #1 = 0.57, #2 = 3, #4 = 760
note: The shield: 「抵消等同于三月七 **57% 防御力 + 760** 伤害的护盾，持续 3 回合」。 ⚠ `scale: owner_def` + `amount` is the 「share plus a constant」 shape (added 2026-09-27 for this sentence): `percent` of the **rule owner's** DEFENCE plus the flat 760, computed when the rule fires and then held by the shield. The engine stores one shield value and a new shield **overwrites** it instead of stacking, which is what 「提供…护盾」 means. ⚠ The numbers are the **Lv10** row the prose quotes -- the engine's characters are all at skill level 1, so reading 「the skill's own level」 would give 0.38 + 190: the same 「which row」 question `damage_level` answers where an op reads a table, registered with M-32. ⚠ NOT written from this Skill: the taunt clause 「若该目标当前生命值百分比大于等于 30%，被敌方攻击的概率大幅提高」 -- `target_hp_percent` and the `TAUNT` op both exist now, and it is STILL not written, for a reason that is not about vocabulary: the sentence raises a **probability** (「被敌方攻击的概率大幅提高」) and the document states **no magnitude anywhere**, while `TAUNT` is a hard constraint (while it is up, a single-target attack can only pick the taunter). Using it would replace a soft weight with a hard lock -- a different mechanic, not a different number -- so it remains a registered data gap. ⚠ `turns: 3` **is** honoured now: the shield is a timed `ShieldBuff` and its duration is counted in the **shielded ally's** own turns, which is what 「持续3回合」 means. Before 2026-09-27 that field was read, validated, and then silently dropped (nothing ever took the shield off), which also made every 「持有护盾的」 clause true for the rest of the battle. ⚠ Still not written from this Skill: 行迹「加护」 (「战技提供的护盾持续时间增加<1>回合」) -- lengthening a buff that is already up has no spelling (a rule can create a shield, not extend one), and 星魂 6's 「在**战技提供的**护盾保护下」 needs the shield's provider to be askable.

source: 1001 三月七 行迹 纯洁 (1001101): 「施放战技时，解除指定我方单体的1个负面效果。」
note: Her kit is a wall of shields, and this is the one clause of it that today's vocabulary can carry completely. ⚠ `target` is the ally the Skill was AIMED at (M-35), which is what 「指定我方单体」 names; her Skill is a `Defence` skill, so it fires SKILL_CAST with no hit targets and this rule is the whole of its effect today. ⚠ `DISPEL` reaches **negative** buffs only, which is exactly what 「解除…1 个负面效果」 says (the five debuff classes answer `isDebuff()` in one table -- DebuffTest). ⚠ Her kit is written clause by clause, and what is NOT written is registered rather than approximated -- each blocked clause and the capability it needs: ① 战技的护盾 ✅ **WRITTEN** -- it is the first rule in this file (`scale: owner_def` + `amount: 760` + `turns: 3`); ② 战技的嘲讽 stayed out on purpose (the reason is in the shield rule's note: a soft weight with no magnitude, against a hard-lock op); ③ 终结技的冻结「有 50% 基础概率陷入冻结状态，持续 1 回合…每回合开始时受到等同于三月七 60% 攻击力的冰属性附加伤害」 -- 冻结 is a control state the engine deliberately does not model yet (P10-2 composes controls out of a StunBuff plus a speed debuff plus an action delay), so there is nothing for a rule to apply or to ask about; ④ 天赋「当**持有护盾的**我方目标受到敌方目标攻击后…立即向攻击者发起反击…每回合可触发 2 次」 ✅ **WRITTEN (2026-09-27)** -- it is the third rule in this file, and it needed exactly the two capabilities that were added for it: the `has_shield` condition and a per-turn **count** (`per_turn: 2`, because `cooldown: 1` can only ever say 「一次」 and a counter with no limit fires on every hit of a three-hit attack); ⑤ the rest is registered: 行迹「加护」 (护盾 +1 回合) and 星魂 6 (「在**战技提供的**护盾保护下的我方目标，每回合开始时回复 4% 生命上限 + 106」) both need the shield's **provider / an existing buff's duration** to be expressible -- the engine remembers the provider (`ShieldBuff.getSource()`) but no condition exposes it, and nothing can lengthen a buff that is already up; 星魂 2 (「进入战斗时，为当前生命值百分比**最低**的我方目标提供 24% 防御力 + 320 的护盾，持续 3 回合」) needs a 「生命百分比最低的队友」 **selector** (the DSL can compare HP, it cannot pick a minimum); 星魂 4 (「天赋的反击每回合可触发次数增加 1 次；反击伤害提高，提高数值等同于三月七防御力的 30%」) needs a passive that **raises another rule's limit** (a second rule with `per_turn: 3` would ADD firings rather than raise the cap) plus a damage **addend** derived from DEF; 星魂 1 (「终结技每冻结 1 个目标，为三月七恢复 6 点能量」) and 行迹「冰咒」 (+15% freeze chance) ride on ③; 星魂 3/5 are the skill-level gap already registered (M-32). ⚠ The 秘技 (100107) is a MAP attack -- the engine has no in-battle event for techniques, so it is out of scope rather than blocked.

source: 1001 三月七 天赋 少女的特权 (100104, 单体攻击/Ice): 「当持有护盾的我方目标受到敌方目标攻击后，三月七立即向攻击者发起反击，对其造成等同于三月七100%攻击力的冰属性伤害，该效果每回合可触发2次。」 param Lv10 = [1, 2] → #1 = 1（伤害倍率），#2 = 2（每回合可触发次数）
note: Every clause of this sentence is carried by one piece of vocabulary, and each piece is the one that makes a *different* wrong reading impossible. ① 「受到…攻击后」 is `TAKING_HIT`, not `HP_LOST`: TAKING_HIT fires whenever an incoming damage instance lands, **including when the shield absorbs all of it** (hpLoss == 0), and this talent is precisely about a shielded ally -- gating it on HP loss would have skipped the case it exists for. ② 「持有护盾的我方目标」 is `target has_shield`, read from the alive shield value (a shield that has been used up no longer qualifies). ⚠ 「我方」 is not a condition: TAKING_HIT is only ever delivered for a subject on our side (Battle.fireTriggersForAlly), which is why the event is the right one for this sentence and `HP_LOST` (either side) would not be. ③ 「受到**敌方目标**攻击」 is `!actor is_ally` -- the event's `actor` is the attacker, and without the condition a friendly-fire instance would be countered as well. ④ 「向攻击者发起反击」 is `target: "attacker"`. ⑤ 「每回合可触发2次」 is `per_turn: 2` (param #2), counted in **三月七's own** turns, exactly like `cooldown`: without it the counter would fire on every hit of a three-hit attack -- a wrong number with nothing to report. ⚠ It is the first user of both `has_shield` and `per_turn`. ⑥ The numbers are not written here: `skill: "TALENT"` + `damage_param: 0` + `damage_level: 10` reads 1 (100% ATK, the Lv10 row the prose quotes) and the Ice element and single-target shape come from 100104's own data. ⚠ `damage_level: 10` is required, not decoration: every skill in this engine is level 1, so the skill's own level would read 0.5 (50%) -- half the damage, with nothing to report (M-32). ⚠ 「反击也属于追加攻击」 holds automatically: `DAMAGE` settles through `Battle.applyAdditionalDamage`, the engine's one notion of a follow-up attack, which is also what emits FOLLOW_UP. ⚠ NOT authored: 星魂 4 raises this cap to 3 and adds 30% of her DEFENCE to the counter's damage -- a second rule with `per_turn: 3` would *add* firings rather than raise this rule's cap (there is no "modify another rule's limit" mechanism), and the damage addend is a derived flat value no op can express; 星魂 1 (energy per frozen target) and 行迹「冰咒」 (+15% freeze chance) need the freeze control state; 星魂 2 needs a 「生命值百分比最低的队友」 selector; 星魂 6 and 行迹「加护」 need the shield's provider / a way to lengthen a shield that is already up.

source: 1001 三月七 终结技 冰刻箭雨之时 (100103, 全体攻击/Ice) 第二句: 「受到攻击的敌方目标有50%基础概率陷入冻结状态，持续1回合。冻结状态下，敌方目标不能行动同时每回合开始时受到等同于三月七60%攻击力的冰属性附加伤害。」 param Lv10 = [1.5, 0.5, 1, 0.6] → #2 = 0.5（基础概率），#3 = 1（持续回合），#4 = 0.6（每回合冰属性附加伤害 = 60% 攻击力）
note: The FIRST sentence of this ultimate (「对敌方全体造成等同于三月七150%攻击力的冰属性伤害」) needs no rule at all -- it is the engine's ordinary AoE path, reading 100103's own Lv10 row. This rule is the second sentence, and every clause of it is stated: ① 「受到攻击的敌方目标」 is `target: "all_enemies"` (the ultimate hits every enemy, so 'the ones hit' IS the enemy camp); ② 「有50%**基础**概率」 is `base_chance: 0.5` -- a *base* chance, rolled **per target** through the real pipeline (Battle.hitChance: base × (1 + 三月七's 效果命中) × (1 − the victim's 效果抵抗) × (1 − its STAT_CTRL_Frozen resistance)), which is why it is not the rule-level `chance` (that one is a single fixed roll for the whole rule, and could never let one of three enemies freeze and another not); ③ 「陷入冻结状态」 is `control: 冻结` -- the state's own name, the same spelling `has_state` reads, and the same state an Ice **break** leaves behind (both paths now attach one `ControlBuff`, so 「冻结状态」 cannot answer differently depending on what froze the victim); ④ 「持续1回合」 is `turns: 1`, required rather than defaulted (a control with no duration would be a permanent lock); ⑤ 「冻结状态下…每回合开始时受到等同于三月七60%攻击力的冰属性附加伤害」 is the state's OWN per-turn damage: `element: Ice` + `scale: self_attr:ATTACK` + `percent: 0.6` (param #4). ⚠ It rides WITH the state -- the `ControlBuff` attaches the `DotBuff` in its `applyEffect` and takes it off in its `removeBuff`, and it is only created on the units the roll let through, so 「冻结状态下」 is not an approximation: a resisted freeze deals no ice damage either. ⚠ The magnitude is read **once, when it lands** and frozen into the DOT -- 「等同于三月七60%攻击力」 means her attack at that moment (the snapshot rule every derived value follows). ⚠ Also NOT authored: 行迹「冰咒」 (「施放终结技时，冻结敌方目标的**基础概率**提高15%」) -- it *raises* the chance of an existing rule, which no vocabulary expresses yet (the M-47 family: a passive that modifies something that already exists; writing it as a second APPLY_CONTROL rule would roll twice instead of raising the chance); 星魂 1 (「终结技每冻结1个目标，为三月七恢复6点能量」) needs a per-cast count of the victims the state actually landed on, which no op can read back.

source: 1001 三月七 星魂 2 记忆中的它 (Avatar_March7th_Rank02): 「进入战斗时，为当前生命值百分比最低的我方目标提供等同于三月七24%防御力+320的护盾，持续3回合。」 param = [0.24, 3, 320]
note: The shield's numbers are the Skill's shape at a different scale (`scale: owner_def` + a constant `amount` + `turns`) -- what this rule needed was the selector: 「当前生命值百分比**最低**的我方目标」, which is a place an effect reaches and not a condition (conditions filter rules, not the units an effect lands on). ⚠ It is `lowest_hp_ally` = the lowest HP **percentage**, and at BATTLE_START everybody is at 100%, so this rule always fires on a tie: the engine's stated tie-break is the earliest unit in the party order, which is why the choice is deterministic instead of luck. ⚠ `turns: 3` is honoured (a timed `ShieldBuff`, counted in the shielded ally's own turns). ⚠ The prose says 「24% 防御力 + 320」 and the shield is applied at the start of the battle, so 三月七's DEFENCE at that moment is what it reads -- she is built before the battle starts, so that is her resolved panel (light cone and relics included) ✓. ⚠ NOT authored from this Eidolon: nothing -- it is the second of her clauses to be complete. 星魂 1/4/6 and 行迹「加护」/「冰咒」 remain registered, together with the reasons (see the talent's and the ultimate's notes).

source: 1001 三月七 行迹 加护 (1001102): 「战技提供的护盾持续时间增加1回合。」
note: 「战技**提供的**护盾持续时间增加1回合」: the rule states the duration and names the buff by its origin -- `buff: 护盾` plus the engine's own "who applied it" filter, which is what 「战技提供的」 says. It fires on the same cast as the Skill, and it sits after the shield rule in this file, which is what makes the shield already be there when it runs (effects of one event run in order; only *conditions* are all evaluated up front -- see ControlTest.aRuleCanGateOnTheFrozenState). ⚠ The +1 is deliberately NOT folded into the Skill's `turns: 3`: that would erase this trace's own line from the data and make the Skill state a duration that is not its own (and a trace could one day be gated on its own). ⚠ It lengthens exactly one buff: 三月七's timed buffs on that ally are the shield (fresh, because the Skill's own rule just re-applied it); anything else of hers carries a different name and is not touched.

source: 1001 三月七 星魂 1 记忆中的你 (Avatar_March7th_Rank01): 「终结技每冻结1个目标，为三月七恢复6点能量。」 param = [6]
note: 「终结技**每冻结1个目标**，为三月七恢复6点能量」 -- the count is how many targets this ultimate's freeze actually landed on, which is the one thing only the engine knows: her 终结技 rolls 50% per target, so against three enemies the answer can be 0, 1, 2 or 3. `scale: cast_applied:冻结` reads exactly that (Battle.recordCastApplied, filled by APPLY_CONTROL only when the roll passed) and `percent: 6` is the energy per landed application -- the same `percent × source` arithmetic 星期日's `target_max_energy` uses. ⚠ It is NOT `per_target: true`: that multiplies by the number of targets the ultimate aimed at (always 3 here), so a fully resisted ultimate would still pay 18 energy -- a wrong number with nothing to report. ⚠ This rule must come after the freeze rule above it: the effects of one event run in order, and this one reads what that one has landed so far (the same ordering fact the 加护 trace records; CastAppliedCountTest pins the shipped file, so a reorder goes red). ⚠ Not counted: a freeze left by an Ice break during the ultimate. The counter counts applications that went through the resist pipeline (Battle.tryApplyDebuff), while a break-attached control deliberately bypasses resistance, and 「每冻结1个目标」 is about the state this ability applies -- paying for break-freezes as well would be the aggressive reading of a sentence that does not distinguish them. ⚠ No `target`: 「为三月七恢复」 is the rule's owner, which is GAIN_ENERGY's default. ⚠ `min_eidolon: 1` is the gate: at 星魂 0 the freeze still happens and no energy is paid, and CastAppliedCountTest measures both halves of that contrast.

source: 1001 三月七 星魂 4 不愿再失去 (Avatar_March7th_Rank04) 第一句: 「天赋的<u>反击</u>效果每回合可触发的次数增加1次。」 param = [1, 0.3]
note: 「天赋的反击效果每回合可触发的次数**增加1次**」 -- the counter's `per_turn` goes from 2 to 3, and this is the sentence that says why `MODIFY_RULE` exists instead of "just write another rule": a second rule with `per_turn: 3` would add firings (the engine would fire 2 + 3 = 5 times a turn) and look perfectly reasonable in the file. `rule: "counter"` names the talent rule above by its `id`, `amount: 1` is how many extra firings per turn (a count -- a probability would be `percent`), and the engine files the amendment on 三月七 herself for this battle (rules are compiled once per cid and cached, so writing 3 onto the rule would leak into every battle in the JVM). ⚠ `BATTLE_START` + `min_eidolon: 4` is the shape of a 星魂: unconditional for the whole fight, so the amendment never has to be taken back. ⚠ Load-time checks make the wrong shapes loud: an unknown id, a target rule that states no `per_turn` (nothing to raise -- and 0 + 1 would silently IMPOSE a one-per-turn cap), both `amount` and `percent`, or any other field. ⚠ The stated `per_turn: 2` stays in the talent rule: the file's own number and the raise are two facts, and folding them into one would erase this 星魂's line (the same reason 加护 does not touch the Skill's `turns: 3`). ⚠ NOT authored from this 星魂 (registered): the second sentence 「使反击造成的伤害值提高，提高数值等同于三月七防御力的30%」 -- it raises the counter's damage by a value derived from an attribute, and `BOOST_DAMAGE` takes a percentage of the instance's damage, not an addend computed from somebody's DEFENCE; the engine has no "+X damage, where X = 30% of my DEF" spelling yet, so writing 30% as a damage boost would be a different (and much larger) number. ⚠ 2026-09-28: the SECOND sentence is now written -- it is the `DEALING_DAMAGE` rule right below this one, and the two together make this 星魂 complete.

source: 1001 三月七 星魂 4 不愿再失去 (Avatar_March7th_Rank04) 第二句: 「使反击造成的伤害值提高，提高数值等同于三月七防御力的30%。」 param = [1, 0.3]
note: 「使**反击**造成的伤害值提高，提高数值等同于三月七**防御力的30%**」 -- 这是**一个数值**，不是"伤害提高百分之多少"：`ADD_DAMAGE` 把它加到这次实例的**基数层**（`Damage.addFlat`，见 `engine.md` 乘区表），所以它和「100% 攻击力」那个倍率一样吃增伤/暴击/防御/抗性；写成 `BOOST_DAMAGE`（增伤区 `1 + Σ`）只有在这段伤害的基数恰好等于防御力时才相等 —— 一个看起来像做完了的错数字，`AddDamageOpTest` 专门钉住了这一对不相等。⚠ `scale: self_attr:DEFENCE` 的算术与 `MODIFY_ATTR` 的派生值**共用一处**（`derivedMagnitude`：`percent × 规则主人的属性 + amount`），读的是**触发那一刻**她的防御力（引擎既有的快照口径）。⚠ 两条条件都承重：`actor == self` 排除别人打的伤害，**`from_skill TALENT`** 排除她自己的普攻/战技/终结技 —— 只有天赋的反击是 `TALENT` 槽位（这是上一轮 `from_skill` 能力的第二个读者）。⚠ `min_eidolon: 4` 与上面那条 `MODIFY_RULE` 同属星魂 4：两句都出货之后，这个星魂**完整**了。

source: 1001 三月七 行迹 冰咒 (1001103): 「施放终结技时，冻结敌方目标的<u>基础概率</u>提高15%。」
note: 「施放终结技时，冻结敌方目标的**基础概率**提高15%」 -- the freeze rule above states `base_chance: 0.5` and this raises it to **0.65**. `percent: 0.15` is how much more likely (a fraction of 1 -- a count would be `amount`), and the raise is filed on 三月七 for the battle, so the stated 0.5 in her file stays exactly the number the document gives. ⚠ Why not a second freeze rule with `base_chance: 0.65`: it would roll twice -- 1 − 0.5 × 0.35 = 82.5% instead of 65% -- and it would also apply the freeze's per-turn damage twice, with nothing anywhere reporting a problem. ⚠ Why `BATTLE_START`: the sentence's condition (「施放终结技时」) is already the event the raised rule fires on, and the trace is a passive -- there is no state to end, so an amendment made once for the battle is the whole mechanic. ⚠ Only `APPLY_CONTROL` reads a base-chance amendment today (it is the only op with a roll whose chance the documents raise), and `RuleAmendmentTest`'s boundary case pins 0.65 exactly: a roll of 0.6 lands and 0.7 does not.

source: 1001 三月七 星魂 6 就这样，一直… (Avatar_March7th_Rank06): 「在<u>战技提供的</u>护盾保护下的我方目标，每回合开始时回复等同于各自4%生命上限+106的生命值。」 param = [0.04, 106]
note: Two clauses, and the first one is the whole reason this rule needed a new condition: 「在**战技提供的**护盾保护下的」 names the ability, not just the giver. ⚠ 三月七 has two shields of her own -- her Skill's (`id: "skill_shield"`, above) and 星魂 2's at battle start -- so a condition that only asked 「有盾」 or even 「我给的盾」 would heal an ally through the 星魂 2 shield as well, for the three turns it lasts: a wrong number with nothing to report. `has_shield from_rule skill_shield` reads exactly that rule's shield (`CanHit.getShieldRuleId()`, stamped on every buff a rule creates), and the negative case is pinned by `ShieldOriginConditionTest`: an ally holding only the battle-start shield is not healed. ⚠ 「各自4%生命上限」 is `scale: target_max_hp` + `percent: 0.04` -- a share of the RECIPIENT's own maximum, computed per target (that is what the scale family does; `owner_max_hp` would read 三月七's). The flat `+ 106` rides in `amount`, the 「share plus a constant」 shape the Skill's shield already uses. ⚠ The trigger 「每回合开始时」 is `TURN_START`, whose event carries the unit whose turn is beginning as BOTH `actor` and `target` -- so the rule fires once per ally per round, with `target` being the one to heal. ⚠ A turn start belongs to whoever's turn it is, so an enemy's turn start delivers the same event with `target` = that enemy: the condition is false for it (our shields are never on enemies), which is why no side filter is needed. ⚠ `min_eidolon: 6` is the gate. ⚠ This is the LAST clause of hers that today's vocabulary can carry completely: what remains registered is 星魂 3/5 (skill levels, `M-32`) and 战技's soft taunt (the document states no magnitude).
